sources: RIDB campsite catalog for facility 232606 (trip_data/ridb_campsites.json, fetched 2026-10-20)
Google Maps place 'Holiday Campground' (33.0158,-85.1890; 4.3 stars, 278 reviews; phone 706-884-6818), read 2026-10-29

values.note: $26 a night for a non-electric site, $36 for an electric site (double electric sites $72), the same every night of the 2026 and 2027 seasons. $10 fee to change or cancel. Card only at West Point Lake campgrounds.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232606/rates (Peak Season 2026-03-20 to 2026-09-07 and 2027-03-19 to 2027-09-06: STANDARD ELECTRIC 36, STANDARD NONELECTRIC 26, STANDARD ELECTRIC u48 72); campground cancellation_description ('A $10.00 service fee will apply if you change or cancel your reservation'), read 2026-10-29

hookups.source: RIDB campsite catalog 232606 (100 reservable 'STANDARD ELECTRIC' sites: 'Electricity Hookup' 50 at 34, 30 at 66; 'Water Hookup' Yes at all but the non-electric sites; no sewer attribute anywhere), fetched 2026-10-20

values.note: 107 bookable RV sites (100 electric, 7 non-electric), every one 23 ft or longer (23-83 ft); one pull-through, the rest back-ins. Plus 4 tent-only sites and two group camping areas. Recreation.gov's description says 112 campsites.

sites.source: RIDB campsite catalog 232606 (reservable STANDARD ELECTRIC / STANDARD NONELECTRIC sites, 'Max Vehicle Length', 'Driveway Entry'); https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232606 ('112 campsites and two group camping areas'), read 2026-10-29

values.note: 2026 season March 20 - September 7; 2027 March 19 - September 6 (around Labor Day). No sites are offered on recreation.gov in October 2026.

season.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232606/rates (Peak Season 2026-03-20 to 2026-09-07, 2027-03-19 to 2027-09-06) + availability months 2026-10 (no sites) and 2027-03 (open from 03-19), read 2026-10-29

values.note: 14 nights in any rolling 30 days. Bookable up to the day of arrival. Check-in after 4 pm, check-out 3 pm; arriving more than a day late cancels the reservation. Gates locked 10 pm - 7 am. Four vehicles per site including the RV and boat trailers.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232606 (facility_rules: minWeekendStay 2, minHolidayWeekendStay 3, maxStay 14 nights / Rolling 30 Days, reservationCutOff 0 days; notices: check-in/out, no-show, gates, vehicle limit), read 2026-10-29

note: USACE Mobile District campground on a forested peninsula on the west shore of West Point Lake, off Thompson Rd west of LaGrange. Boat ramp, basketball and tennis courts, playground. --Claude
summary: Recreation.gov + RIDB catalog: 107 bookable RV sites (100 electric 30/50 A + water, 7 non-electric), all 23-83 ft, one pull-through; $26 / $36 (doubles $72) every night 2026 and 2027 (stored 26-36 confirmed); showers, flush toilets, dump; seasonal Mar 19/20 - Sep 6/7 (no season was stored); 2-night weekend / 3-night holiday minimum, 14 in 30; military discount rule. Note trimmed of counts/hookups/lengths/facilities/booking. Pin matches Google. Waterfront contradicts recreation.gov - see flag.
flags: Waterfront re-audit lead: stored 'not waterfront', but recreation.gov calls it 'a waterfront facility on the western shore of West Point Lake' on a forested peninsula that 'overlooks the 25,900-acre lake'. Suggest a waterfront re-audit (per-site positions on imagery).
